items.prompt: Earlier accepted IDs are {A} and last=5. All fields of B,X,S,1,1,5 are valid. What happens?

options.why: Ordering rejects only strictly smaller timestamps. Equality is allowed.
B is not an accepted ID. Timestamp equality does not make an ID a duplicate.

options.text: OK; clear seen before adding B
options.why: Accepting a same-time record must not erase earlier accepted IDs.
The new ID passes and equality is allowed; commit the record without resetting previous state.
